signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the same account as in the QuaDev mobile app.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: One account for the web and the QuaDev mobile app.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a special character.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Please, enter your email address. We will send you a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.success:
If an account exists for that email, we've sent it a link to reset the password.

Open the link to choose a new password, then sign in.
forgotPassword.error: There was an error sending the password reset email

emailVerification.title: Welcome to
emailVerification.emailSent: We've sent a verification email to {{email}}.
emailVerification.emailVerificationInstructions: Open the link in the email, then come back and press "I've verified my email".
emailVerification.notVerifiedYet: Your email isn't verified yet. Open the link in the email, then try again.

completeProfile.title: Complete your profile
completeProfile.subtitle: Tell us your name to finish setting up your account. Your date of birth is optional.

deleteAccount.title: Are you sure?
deleteAccount.description: We’re sorry to see you go. Deleting your account will permanently erase all your data, and you will lose access to the app. However, you’re always welcome to create a new account if you decide to return.
deleteAccount.reauthDescription: For your security, enter your password to confirm that you want to delete your account.
deleteAccount.googleWindowNotice: Continue in the Google window that opened.
deleteAccount.successMessage: Your account has been successfully deleted.
deleteAccount.unavailableOnWeb: This account signs in with Apple, which the website does not support yet. To delete it, use the QuaDev mobile app, or write to us from the account's email address.

home.welcomeDescription: Your account is ready. New tools will show up here as they are released.
home.mockInterviewDescription: Practise with an AI interviewer that asks the questions and follows up on your answers.
home.liveInterviewDescription: Short bullet points for each question while you are being interviewed, with a review afterwards.
home.cvToolDescription: Improve your CV and create versions tailored to each job.

publicHome.title: Building robust software solutions
publicHome.description: One QuaDev account for the web and the mobile app. New tools will arrive here as they are released.
publicHome.descriptionWithAccount: One QuaDev account for the web and the mobile app. Create it today; new tools will arrive here as they are released.
publicHome.signUpCardDescription: Use your email, Google or Apple. The same account works in the mobile app.
publicHome.dataCardDescription: Your name and email are enough. Your date of birth is optional.
publicHome.deleteCardDescription: You can delete your account and all its data at any time.

deleteAccountInfo.title: Delete your account
deleteAccountInfo.description: You can delete your QuaDev account at any time. Deleting it is permanent.
deleteAccountInfo.stepConfirm: Confirm. You may be asked for your password again.
deleteAccountInfo.erasedDescription: Your account and its profile: your name, your email, your date of birth if you gave it, and the data linked to your account.
deleteAccountInfo.permanentDescription: A deleted account cannot be restored. You can create a new account later.
deleteAccountInfo.emailDescription: If you cannot use the app, send an email from the address of your account to the address below and ask us to delete it.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist or has moved.

fieldError.emailFormatError: Please enter a valid email address
fieldError.firstNameLengthError: First name must be less than 30 characters
fieldError.lastNameLengthError: Last name must be less than 30 characters
fieldError.dobFutureError: Date cannot be in the future
fieldError.dobFormatError: Date of birth format is invalid
fieldError.passwordLengthError: Must be at least 8 characters long
fieldError.passwordLowercaseError: Must contain at least one lowercase letter
fieldError.passwordUppercaseError: Must contain at least one uppercase letter
fieldError.passwordNumberError: Must contain at least one number
fieldError.passwordSpecialCharacterError: Must contain at least one special character
fieldError.termsRequiredError: Please agree to the terms and conditions

error.unexpectedErrorRetry: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
error.serverSideError: There was an error. If the problem persist please contact support.
error.tooManyRequestsError: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
error.requiresRecentLogin: For your security, please sign in again and retry.
error.userDisabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact support.
error.accountExistsWithDifferentCredential: An account already exists with this email. Sign in with the method you used before.
error.reauthUserMismatch: That account doesn't match the one you're signed in with.
error.accountUnavailable: Sign-in on the web is not available yet.
error.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
